text_block_list.name: Phalaeno & Dober
text_block_list.text:
“HAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!” 
“HAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!”
choice_data_list: Reach it... Reach it... REACH IIIIIT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Even from here, I can hear my 
Trainer's voice. 
Fuel added to the hearth, the furnace 
blazing—urging me to fulfill it.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The time has come. To answer the club's 
devotion. 
The fervent hopes of my peers and the 
young fillies. 
My Trainer's tireless dedication—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And to live up to the expectations I 
placed upon myself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—do not touch it. 
Vacate the throne!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I will never, ever surrender it...!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: The queen is—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She's fast, so fast!! Here she comes, 
Phalaenopsis! It's Phalaenopsis!! 
Phalaenopsis crosses the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... Ahaha. 
...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Did you see? Did you bear witness? 
...We did it. We really did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: We reached this future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes, we reached it. 
Together. We finally made it here...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
All the way to a place like this... Haha! 
I see. I see...

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Miss Phalaenoooo!! Congraaatulationsーー!! 
I'm so, so hap... *sniff*, *sob*...!!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... You're amazing, truly 
amazing...! 
You really... all this time, leading up to 
today—!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
For constantly living up to our 
expectations... 
For showing us this view, thank you so 
much...!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......I seized it. At last.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —One dream, finally rewarded.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ......Good race out there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
... 
It was just as you said, Lady Dober.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You were strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Thanks. 
Even though you still beat me, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, it's so frustrating! It really 
stings... 
I wasn't carrying any less on my shoulders 
than you were.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm strong, but even more than 
that... 
Phalaeno was stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And that fact just frustrates me to no 
end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, as frustrating as it is... I don't 
have any regrets, yeah. 
I feel like I gave it everything I had in 
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
By the way—the hard part starts now, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Staying the queen. 
Do you think you can do it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
For I am the peerless queen— 
the one who seized the throne from the 
mightiest of queens.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. You're just so cool, 
Phaleno. It's really not fair...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's time to show your face out 
there. 
As the new queen.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Phalaenopsis!" "Congratulations!!" 
"What an electrifying race!" "You were 
amazing!!" 
"Congratulations!!" "Way to go!!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for your 
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Today, I have become the peerless 
queen of the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no intention of resting on 
my laurels. 
From this moment forth—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Until the day our Club becomes the most 
beautiful garden, 
I intend to reign supreme as its queen.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to the day I may meet 
you all once again in the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have returned.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —I have returned as queen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis was merely stating a fact. 
Yet the moment she spoke those words... 
I found myself on the verge of tears.
choice_data_list:
(No, I need to welcome her with a smile... 
right?)

(No, I have to greet her with a smile... 
don't I?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I choke back the welling emotions, 
fighting them down. 
When suddenly—Phalaenopsis gently 
rests her hand against my cheek.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Your expression has grown truly resolute.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You need not hold back. Just for today, I 
shall permit it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There is no one else here now. 
So, it is all right.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Let it all out.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...There are countless things I wish to 
tell you. 
Yet... if I am to speak my true heart, 
there is only one.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You have given me a future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That I—that Phalaenopsis was able to 
bloom, 
is because you tenderly, ceaselessly 
poured water upon me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You are my pride.
